title: Chapter 1
subtitle: Colter
description: After a failed robbery the gang hides in an abandoned mining town in the Grizzlies, waiting out a late spring storm.

title: Chapter 2
subtitle: Horseshoe Overlook
description: The gang camps above Valentine and begins gathering money, horses, and new leads.

title: Chapter 3
subtitle: Clemens Point
description: Pushed south after Valentine, the gang camps near Rhodes and plays two feuding families against each other.

title: Chapter 4
subtitle: Saint Denis / Shady Belle
description: The gang moves into a decaying manor in the swamps outside Saint Denis while Dutch hunts a way out.

title: Chapter 5
subtitle: Guarma
description: A botched bank job strands several members on a sugar island under a local tyrant.

title: Chapter 6
subtitle: Beaver Hollow
description: The remnants of the gang hide in dangerous country as internal disputes and Arthur’s illness worsen.

title: Epilogue, Part 1
subtitle: Pronghorn Ranch
description: Years later, John takes ranch work and tries to keep his family safe under assumed names.

title: Epilogue, Part 2
subtitle: Beecher's Hope
description: John buys a farm of his own and tries to become a family man, with help and hindrance from old friends.
